paragraphs: Week 6 (Oct 16 – 20, Lectures 11 and 12) Teaching and Learning
4.7 Antiderivatives: definition; Theorem 8; the notation of indefinite integrals.
5.1 Area and estimating with finite sums: estimating areas or other quantities using various sums (left-endpoint, right-endpoint, midpoint, etc.).
5.2 Sigma notation and finite sums: sigma notation; the formulae for the sum of the first n squares and the sum of the first n cubes; the definition of Riemann sums.

5.3 Definite integrals (Riemann integrals): definition (may assume that the function is bounded, for otherwise it would not be integrable); integrability theorem (Theorem 1); properties of definite integrals (Table 5.6); area under the graph of a nonnegative function; average value of a function. (If time is tight, can leave the average value to Week 7.)
